title: Nice product
text: Nice product. With so many stray CDs whose cases took up so much room, I was pleased to receive this product and reduce the amount of space needed to store the CD's.

product_metadata.title: Case Logic KSW-92 Koskin 100 Capacity CD/DVD Prosleeve Wallet (Black)
features: Wallet holds 100 CDs or 46 with booklets
Innovative Fast-File pockets allow quick storage and immediate access to 8 additional favorite or "now playing" CDs or DVDs
Patented ProSleeves provide ultra protection by keeping dirt away to prevent scratching of delicate CD surface
Easy-flip pages lay flat for quick access to CDs
Durable faux leather exterior resistant to moisture and abrasion
description: * Holds 92 CD's or 46 with liner notes * Easy-view index spine label for quick identification of CDs * Sturdy carrying handle * Durable Koskin cover has the look and feel of leather * Easy flip pages lay flat for quick access to CDs.
